episode_title: Wages Vs Inflation, Tennessee Failed Execution, Cornell Rape Case Special Prosecutor
script_en: Wages Vs Inflation, Tennessee Failed Execution, Cornell Rape Case Special Prosecutor.
A new jobs report offers the latest look at a slowing labor market as workers deal with wages that are not keeping up with prices and higher borrowing costs.
Tennessee has paused executions after Christa Pike survived two doses of a lethal injection drug, marking the state’s second failed execution this year.
New York’s governor has appointed a special prosecutor in the Cornell sexual assault case after new questions emerged about what information campus police shared with the local district attorney.
